data.one_liner: A performant list view that handles any number of items using a fixed-size cache.
data.what_it_does: It provides a ListView replacement capable of handling millions of items by maintaining a fixed-size cache of pages, discarding old pages as new ones are loaded asynchronously. It uses an internal ScrollablePositionedList and a DraggableScrollbar to support item-based scrolling and custom thumbs.
use_when: You need to display massive or infinite lists containing hundreds of thousands or millions of items.
Items have varying heights and you want to maintain high scrolling performance.
You want to fetch data in pages asynchronously without keeping all items in memory.
avoid_when: You only need to display a small, fixed list of items where standard Flutter lists suffice.
You require tight integration with the platform's standard Scrollbar rather than the custom draggable scrollbar.
strengths: Handles massive or infinite item counts without memory bloating.
Supports items with non-uniform heights without performance loss.
Provides built-in caching via external or internal LRU maps and custom scroll thumbs.
weaknesses: Does not play nice with the regular Flutter Scrollbar, requiring its own DraggableScrollbar.
Requires async page loaders rather than simple synchronous lists.
